params.body:
Ilse's third list of 2026-09-17 (mail 17:01), task 1: the stock of garage Heuten was imported from AutoScout through Hexon (partner API). The vehicles arrived without chassis number and with "dirty" descriptions, and the dealer wants the Car-Pass pdf.

## What changes for the dealer

- **An imported vehicle without chassis number opens on the Type step** (Livewire sheet), where the chassis number and the lookup button are. Every other vehicle keeps opening on Algemeen; an explicit `?tab=` still wins. The classic sheet has no Type tab: there the chassis number sits on Algemeen, already the default, and the header button is already primary while the number is empty. (R S1-9.24)
- **The chassis lookup on a complete sheet fills only what is empty.** Mileage, prices and texts that came in through Hexon stay. A draft ("wagen toevoegen") is filled as before. The AutoConnect equipment step (options) is skipped in that mode, as the existing batch command already did. (R S1-2.19)
- **Descriptions from the API (and the Modix XML) are stored as plain text**: tags out, entities decoded, Windows line endings and whitespace tidy, no words removed. A description a dealer types on the sheet is never touched. (R P3-2.11, R S1-4.9)

## How

- Migration `2026_09_17_140000_add_created_via_to_vehicles`: `vehicles.created_via` (varchar 16, nullable), set to `api` by `VehicleApiService::storeVehicle`. Backfill: rows with `created_by IS NULL` become `api`, because every other path (sheet, copy, import commands, Modix) sets `created_by` and only the API path never did. Online DDL, no table copy.
- `Vehicle::startsOnTypeStep()`, `VehicleForm::initialStep($vehicle)`; the copy ("Dupliceren") drops `created_via`.
- `OwnStockController::createFromVIN` passes `$onlyEmpty = is_complete` to `createFromCarVwe` and `updateByAutoConnect`, which already had the parameter for `stocklist:fetchRequiredFieldsByChassisNumber`. The `echo` in `tempupdate`'s fill-empty branch is removed (it came out in the HTTP response).
- `App\Support\ImportedText::clean()`, called from `ImportVehicle::fillDataArr` (API) and `doImport` (Modix).

## Investigated, no code (findings)

- `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-17-hexon-chassisnummer-leeg-na-import.md`: the API reads the VIN from **`main.vin` only**; any other key is ignored silently; for a non-premium partner (Hexon rules) it is nullable, so the vehicle is created without it. Our mapping does not drop it. What to ask Hexon, and where `api_log` shows what they send. Pinned as R P3-2.12.
- `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-17-hexon-car-pass-pdf-enkel-url.md`: the API stores `main.carpass` in `carpass_id` (the public VHR hyperlink, `https://public.car-pass.be/vhr/<key>`); the pdf only exists in `carpass_requests` when the platform did the registration itself. Options for Ilse: fetch from the URL in a job (only after checking what it serves), or an own registration once the chassis number is there (recommended).

## Tests

`tests/Unit/ImportedTextTest.php` (5), `tests/Feature/HexonImportTest.php` (9: API without `main.vin` creates a vehicle marked `api`; `main.vin` stored; description cleaned on the API path, not on the sheet; Livewire sheet opens on Type / Algemeen; lookup asks fill-empty mode on a complete sheet and not on a draft; fill-empty keeps filled values). `php bin/rules-sources`: Geen problemen. Also green: Alpine/Handler/CompiledViews/Stylesheet guards, Rules*, VinLookupMessageTest, PartnerApiTest, ChassisTwinsTest, VehicleSheetHeaderTest.
params.title: Hexon import: open on Type, lookup fills empty fields only, clean descriptions
